notes.title: DevLog 8 - 08/15/2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f2eedd57fcca894fdbc1e100281b2e1c41a20092.jpg


Hey folks!

There havn't been updates for quite some time however a lot of stuff is happening in the background right now. We have moved into the next phase of the project which is one of the most important milestones for the entire game and we are all very excited about the content we are about to release! As we had to add a lot of core features including Game UI elements, we couldn't release an update because with the changes we made and the features we added the game was literally not playable. Fortunately many things are now in the work that will improve gameplay in pretty much all aspects. Good news is those features and gameplay elements won't take much more time as we are nearing completion of it.

Listed below is the new content and features that you can expect with coming updates.

New Menu / Inventory!
It was announced a couple of times that there will be a new GUI which will not only be polished but also come with entirely new features, pages, detailled descriptions and other cool changes. Finally we can realize all of that which will increase fun gameplay and improve balancing as well due to the new Character Stats System.

(Some of the displayed images and numbers are just previews but not the final version.)

The Character page is the main space to equip your character and compare gear stats such as damage, defense, elemental effects and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/06409d7a094bc679a4d4fd339707c7bc449a7c65.png

On the Map page you can read about kingdoms and places you have travelled to. Each larger area such as Aclendi Woods has a lot of smaller areas to explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/0576c284dc97fd1702f3f893c3af3d884bcc4dcd.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f9a84f191e0f95e5365d73b7b3a342eff74d46bc.jpg

Improved Level Up Scaling
We have changed up some things regarding leveling the character. Points that you spend on Character Attributes such as Strength, Wisdom, Magic etc have now a more meaningful impact on your character as a whole. This will allow you to manage your character stats very well and slowly build up your own character class. Next to that we have lowered the Statpoints per level from 4 to 3 which is due to the coming Destinyboard feature that we will talk about it in this DevLog, too.

Everything has been redesigned allowing better navigation. With the new Statpoints page all previous bugs and issues will also be fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/cb31d181966a76bb5939d1af339dc0761fd5696b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/893f910c795fc7f5f1f796bff9b5baf6e43cf5fb.png

Better Stats System
The system to show Weapon Stats, Character Attributes and compare equipment details was not completed and served as a placeholder for something better. Therefore we now realized a stats system which will give you a better overview. Additionally it offers you insight about the real damage and defense values which is a crucial feature for Apprentice Arriving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d0d603fb830454e799d616eab35fdc8db5df5bd1.jpg

First Destinyboard version is coming!
This is something we have been waiting for for a long time. With the new Game UI we are able to implement the Destinyboard! This is one of the core elements in the game that impacts gameplay and the character growth on a massive scale. The Destinyboard will track how you play and your skills improve passively by performing them. But that is by far not all about this feature. There is much more to it but it will stay a secret until it is actually released with an update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/47bda407aad0abd74b9b0fa3c8093d2b6bc38510.png

Optimized Quest System
With the new UI, completed and accepted quests are saved and stored in a list whereas before, each completed quest disappeared which was a problem. The Quests page will give you a good overview about your accepted and completed quests while showing you all information about each quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/91b8c8358917bf068c5c2c484510aba1494a764d.jpg

Next Finished Area in Aclendi Woods Part III
While a lot of working hours are invested into UI and gameplay features we are also completing other level sections that come with Aclendi Woods Part III. Once vital core features and the UI is done those areas will be accessible to you.

Area: Charred Paths
This is a small area where brutal enemies are waiting for stumbling travellers. The area is for strong characters only so we do not recommend setting foot in it if your character is still on a low level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/08a310bdd56c4285a59c1d0e05f0e8729c597cfe.jpg

Village, Buildings and Shops!
We have completed numerous houses, shops and other buildings. Currently we are also working on the NPCs and interior design. In Village Vesponet you will be able to buy items, weapons, potions and other useful stuff for the journey. The village is gonna serve as a hub from where you can enter the next area. After Vesponet has been completed Aclendi Woods Part III will be unlocked shortly after and the main story will continue. There is also a watermill next to Aldermans house now and some quests are slightly changed up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/187d8bc53be201beeceedcc9272785bbb0ba58f0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/3316002bc68030432cfe06e26ee7d080215c06fb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d5d58d1fd4edbbabbb6e1771bb62f9791924140c.jpg

Two Enemies in the Making!
One of the enemies is a very nasty tree that was already in the prototype but we have now a polished version. The attack pattern of the tree is also slightly balanced as the old one was a bit too frustrating for some. Don't get us wrong though, it's still a fearsome enemy. The other enemy will actually be a group of enemy types which will mainly appear in Aclendi Woods Part III however we won't reveal more about it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/1b2d49b13edbe164bfebdec2eac569925971a0aa.jpg

New Quests
There are new quests that have been almost completed. You will meet new people and dive deeper into the story. Some quests will also be a bit more challenging preparing you for a dangerous territory and reward you with valuable items.

New Combos + Combo Window
We have been working on new combos and added a few more weapon types such as: Arcane Sword, Runesword and even Daggers for very fast combo movesets. Each weapon type has unique combo moves and slightly different combo sequences. 

Additionally all combos are now named and can be viewed in the Menu making everything more user friendly than it was before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f786d908b5fb4d226698e7e07e22556779dddca2.png

That's it for DevLog 8. There is much more we have been working on over the months but these are the main features and the content that is definitely coming with the next updates. As soon as the Menu is fully completed the game will be playable again. 

After a long phase of planning, optimizing and lots of coding the team is already excited to get back to the action stuff and offer you a great gaming experience!

notes.title: Major Graphics Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/539ff7d727eeae4bd93f50c782558418b0687f37.jpg

Join our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb


Hey folks! We already have another amazing update for you! While we are working on finalizing new quests and characters we have recently massively improved the graphics as well as the atmosphere in the game. There are new ambient sounds, the shadows are much more crisp and the light is brighter and more polished overall which makes enemies, objects like armors and weapons stand out even more than before. But that's not all. Like we said before, we are removing each UI placeholder step by step so expect smaller or bigger visual improvements in each coming update!

What has this update in store for you? Check out the list below:

Higher Graphics And Better Performance!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/222a4424013516c7e98ffb85b870f28b62e14c98.jpg
The light is now brighter at spots where it's needed and darker areas look much more realistic. Shadows casted by leaves are very crisp which give you now a nice feeling of actually walking through a forest. On top of that this rendered light improves the performance again. That being said we are still working on performance drops that are not caused by the environment but by some AI errors and some other small coding issues. But we are very confident that we will soon get to the core issue of this and fix it entirely.

Ambient Sounds Added & Minor Sound Issues Fixed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/8c5ae5bb377d360beb2fa1ff3f2c210f3fdcbdc6.jpg
Each location has now its own athmosphere with fitting ambient sounds of chirping birds and variation of wind sounds. These new sounds make gameplay more immersive and realistic. It's not completely done yet but the closer we get to the final Aclendi Woods version the more sounds will be added to round up the atmosphere, offering you a wonderful gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/3d8e80c27f97d799b308bd50c3522ccd55fa6038.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/4320cbd9fc73557b2b1dafa2fe33de717d386cd6.jpg

Smoother Skin & Color Fixed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/4d5bf0dcc2acfa4ea2fc04585180c5280408d24a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/55080fe15048b42b3012ef4da0c40f8e4baac252.jpg
There was an issue with the human character skin color which made their faces look darker and in a way pale in some areas which was not intended. This issue has finally been fixed!

Combat UI Text Visual Improvement
We are also currently tweaking UI elements such as combat display text and other small things regarding the HUD. Step by step we will remove all placeholders that have been a big help to us for the time being but now it's time to remove them all and make it visually appealing as well as more logical in terms of menu navigation, equipping your character and level up your skills.

That's it for this update! We hope you like this graphics update and we are already cooking up a new enemy that is going to be placed in the level soon. This one is gonna be a real pain that's as much as we can reveal to you.

notes.title: User Experience Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/526d0f4222cbf5be14350484fed4d4c6d8f941f9.jpg

Join our Discord channel:  https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb


A lot of things have been tweaked and improved in this update regarding user experience and UI design. We finally got rid of multiple placeholders, adding improved UI windows and assured easier navigation overall. Next to visual improvements we also balanced the amount of items which results in smoother and more fluent gameplay.

This update is the bridge to another awesome update! We are currently working out new side quests and we are also moving forward with the main story which includes new characters, new items to collect and many other cool stuff!

Check out the list below to see what comes with this update:

Quest Log Window
Instead of the Quest Tracker window that was appearing on the right side underneath the Minimap you can now open a Quest Log window (check Controls for input) where you can see a list of your accepted quests as well as their objectives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/a60210c328a33717d3ddcba1e58e79c273a6474a.jpg

Zoomed in Minimap & Pick Up Items Design
The Minimap is more zoomed in giving you a better overview about what's directly around you. Picked up items now appear in the bottom right corner. Up to 3 items can be simultaneously displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/71d0de66577505bdc7c6e05f8f982af47e187a5f.jpg

Treasure Chest Design
We removed the placeholder pop up window that appeared when you opened treasure chests and added a simple open chest animation. Additionally chest icons now disappear on the Minimap and on the World Map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/63cd444b0df326868d26f0c19e6c43d0f754dd57.png

Improved UI Design
In general we improved a lot of elements on the UI, making them more visually appealing and easier to navigate with. It is important to say that most of the UI elements are still just placeholders and soon we will release an update with the real Menu. 

Take a look at the original Menu here:

[previewyoutube=YrItGRwuNn0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Toggle HUD
You can now hide and unhide all UI elements by pressing "H" on the keyboard and "D-Pad Left" on gamepad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/8f895a42ae81997512d7a6549b949d110936ccbd.jpg

BUG FIXES
Fixed: Some rocks appeared blurry or appeared too late.
Fixed: Controls Menu showed wrong input.
Fixed: Some NPCs didn't appear when they should and others appeared too early.
Fixed: Picking up loot from enemies with gamepad sometimes locked the player from drinking potions.

Other corrections: typos and misleading dialogues have been corrected.

This update allows us to finally move forward with the main story and add new quests to the game! As we have fixed crucial bugs and logic errors that made quest creation a little difficult we can now get to the interesting stuff again!

Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Update Aclendi Woods Part II & New Features
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f976b55f57c9b6620e8c07c7e61fa79f7cf3b468.jpg
We finally made it! The announced Aclendi Woods Part II is now accessible for everyone.
Many people who attended the Polaris Convention 2024 had already the opportunity to dive into the next area with new enemies, new features and lots more to explore! Before we release this update we wanted to make sure that some annoying bugs are fixed ensuring better and smoother gameplay.

New Enemy Types
Like mentioned in DevLog 7 we have added three new enemies. They are much more dangerous than the previous one you encountered so watch your back before it get's stung by the brutal Xanzos!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e4c362ab8cc0be32a84cff8b88793a10d3b6cca8.jpg

Added The Skillplate – An entirely new Combat Feature
This new Head Up Display system announced in News Post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1344520/view/4054997065309476341?l=english is your new way to fend of hordes of enemies in an extremely quick way. It already works very well but we will make it even faster and more responsive in the future which will allow you to chain your attacks super fast. And we ain't gonna lie to you – you will need it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d584028efbfad7a2536eb5c7914c511ae05a4d69.jpg

Weapon Type Greatsword
We have added the Greatsword to the game! This heavy and slow weapon deals massive damage especially if you use the combo attacks correctly. Even if the weapon is huge our Prince Landon is able to wield it with ease and perform attacks that totally question physics and gravity. Many people on the Polaris 2024 loved playing with this weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/32d71d4053872686987427d202490dd776833a41.jpg

Tutorial Changed
Due to the new features replacing all the placeholders the Tutorial is completely different now so make sure to check that out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/c79fb0d2c6fa1284a91b54c8209bf59d56143b57.jpg

Added Tech Skills
Finally we have added Techs to Landons repertoire. These can be powerful physical attacks chanelling Landons enormous energy into a force that slices through armor like a knive through butter.

New Large Areas to Explore
With Aclendi Woods Part II a big area is now accessible with a lot of new hidden Items and Equipment such as Armor, Weapons, Rings etc. Additionally there is a hidden level but we are not going to tell you where obviously. And even if you knew, Hidden Levels are extremely dangerous and challenging. Only the best and sharped minded will survive here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/94f848a9931df0f2d63b5f4a04bab842703ba7d4.jpg

Poison Player Status Effect has been added
With Poison the first player status effect is now in the game. It is just one of many but it really should not be underestimated. As most status effects Poison stacks up which means the more often you get hit the more devastating the Poison amount will be.

Animation Improvements, Balancing and more
To conclude this post we have done a lot of work, tweaking enemy stats to balance them, improved animations to make them look more smooth and added some other elements that you will see. We also want to say that Aclendi Woods Part III is already in the making. We are working tirelessly with the resources we have to finish Aclendi Woods, the first level in the game. Then we will continue with level two The Path of MT. Talarev.
As big updates like this usually come with issues the keyboard are currently not working properly with the new HUD system. So at the moment we highly recommend playing with gamepad. The keyboard bugs will be fixed in the coming small update which is not taking long.

Bug Fixes that come with this update:
Fixed Keyboard attack style Input
Fixed Gamepad attack style Input
Fixed UI Keyboard player getting stuck in Inventory
Fixed UI Keyboard player getting stuck in Level Up Window
Fixed UI Keyboard player disabled enemies with Inventory
Fixed UI Keyboard player could move while a treasure chest was opened
Fixed UI Keyboard player could attack in Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player getting stuck in Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player getting stuck in Level Up Window
Fixed UI Gamepad player disabled enemies with Inventory
Fixed UI Gamepad player could move while a treasure chest was opened
Fixed UI Gamepad player could attack in Inventory

Join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb 

Thank you for your support, have fun and happy gaming wishes you Team Jewel Seeker!

notes.title: DevLog #7 – 10/17/2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/f2566d7bf76e7c003336fd07f99b60109d204423.png

Hi folks!

It is about time that Aclendi Woods Part II is unlocked. While we have worked on many new gameplay features we tested the next part of the level and we are happy to announce that it's finally ready to be published. This part comes with new and more dangerous enemy types, new items and treasures and a lot of areas to explore!

Greatsword Weapon Type
With the next update we will add the Greatsword to the game. Visitors of the Polaris 2024 had already the opportunity to check out some stylish moves and combos that come with it. It is much more sluggish but its combo moves and range balance out this drawback. For players who like the Tank class and prefer to deal a lot of damage with just a few hits, this is the weapon for you.

New Enemy Types
We have created a couple of new enemy types and each one of them has some really nasty skills such as element damage and Poison. Poison is very dangerous. With each hit the Poison amount is increased so you should better avoid getting hit multiple times in a row from the brutal Valpes enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/8e09378bc841d2a51257a8222308bdf60bdd32a2.png

Aclendi Woods Part II
We had a good opportunity to test out the next area at the Polaris Con with many interested players helping us to balance out the area. This level part is huge in comparison to the first part. It includes a lot of new areas with treasures and new items to collect. We will also add more sidequests to it very soon.

People who have already played the game should be familiar with these two knights that have blocked the entrance to part II of the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d96fc6bbe7438c3b1653d0ad1dcf68e58e86a5d9.png

HUD Feauture & Show Globe (Potion System)
Finally we finished the Head Up Display features which allow you to cast spells and use powerful techs very quickly. It also comes with the Mana system that we have previously announced where you can cast spells even without Mana with the cost of losing Health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/7dbcdc6bcfa7db59722e30057e8e8f3f634f898d.jpg

Show Globe System
A new and simple Potion system has been programmed. You can equip Herbs which is then indicated by a bar that is attached to the HUD. In the beginning you only have two Show Globe slots for Herbs but this can be upgraded over time. The Show Globe is your Alchemy flask that you need to mix your own potion by adding ingredients that you can find or purchase. The system is not yet completed as we are in need of the original menu. Here is an example showing you how the Show Globe page will look like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/09ad5ea3c562023e01f9a82b955ceb549c15ab34.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/760bb9683f610aa30d40015530c7846fca253ab9.jpg

Tech Skills Feature
Now you can get a glimpse of Landon's superpower! We have added the Tech Plate to your repertoire which will be very unique skills that you can use to beat even really tough enemies. Next to Techs that deal plenty of damage there will also be skills that allow you to reach higher places or that help you be victorious with tactical moves. At the moment there is only Tech Redemption unlocked. Players of the Polaris Con 2024 had already the opportunity to play around with it. Skills such as Magic and Tech can all be unlocked on the Skilltree that will also come with the menu so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/fd87516aa16e2e31532d7a2910cb5d6dbee97a59.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/cecaad7cd23fdba4d76adc646a2f3bba03c2b329.jpg

Important to mention: Techs use cooldowns and don't consume Mana whereas most Magic spells only need Mana. Later on you can also infuse your Techs with Elements like Fire, Lightning, Ice etc.

Aclendi Woods Part III
Yes we almost completed this part as well allowing you to explore the entire map. It's gonna take some time until we can publish it but rest assured that it's gonna come very soon and it will include the real Boss that is gonna be pretty tough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e7e1da6c82bd83238240ca7ee41f157ef5f3ed92.png

Side Note: Tutorial has been changed
With the new Head Up Display the entire Tutorial has also been changed to adapt it to the new controls.

There are many other things we have tweaked including dialogue and some small bugs have been fixed as well. All in all the next update is gonna completely improve the gaming experience making it more smooth with a faster combat and more difficult enemies. We just have to fix a few other bugs and then we are ready to release the update.

We really hope you enjoyed this DevLog and we are already excited to show you all the other things we have been cooking up behind the scenes.

notes.title: Feature Head Up Display Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Among many other things there is an upcoming update which is centered around our Head Up Display. In the current version it is not possible to use the HUDs full potential and we want to change that. This feature is not just an ordinary HUD, it is something that will guide you through the game and even grows with you, meaning the stronger you will get the more skills are going to be unlocked. We designed a UI that allows you to access your skills fast and easy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/251b4d20b51e8b675b5f6afeecca7e73c78539cc.png

- With power there comes responsibility.

Since you'll learn a lot of powerful spells that can be difficult to balance we thought of a way to make spell casting more challenging. From now on casting spells will not only reduce your Mana Pool but they can also drain your HP (Health Points) for a specific amount.

What does that mean?
Well, each spell costs a certain amount of MP. So if you cast a spell with insufficient MP the difference is subtracted from your HP. When a spell costs 400 MP and you only have 350 then 50 HP is subtracted. But, you cannot cast a spell with 0 MP.

To make things easier a Warning Symbol will show up displaying to you which spells are going to subtract HP and which won't. We want to prevent spamming spells but magic in general can be very effective depending on the situation and the opponent infront of you.

Many spells don't have cooldowns which means you can use them as often as you want in a row however be careful because if your HP is too low and you use a spell that subtracts more than your remaining HP then ...

Well, you will bite the dust.

But no worries, a Skull Symbol will warn you before that can even happen.

Join our Discord Server here: https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb


We are looking forward to implement this cool feature and are going into more details in the next coming update. See you until then!

notes.title: Game Update Released!
notes.content:
IT IS HERE - THE LONG AWAITED UPDATE THAT WILL CHANGE EVERYTHING!

It is finally time to show you what we have been up to the whole time. We are celebrating the publication of a completely transformed version! You can now forget everything you knew about our old version and embrace the latest foundation of Apprentice Arriving!

The 1st of 3 Major Updates specifically for the Aclendi Woods level!

[previewyoutube=N15KZWWT744;full][/previewyoutube]

This update changes the way our game looks and feels entirely. We not only cranked up the graphics and details massively. Today we present you a totally new Aclendi Woods level that is much larger than the previous one. We also want to thank you for your feedback. We fixed some critical weaknesses in our old version which were the lack of a World Map, Minimap and a Tutorial. But there is a lot more to make the game feel more immersive like voice acting for important quests and we did crucial changes to the gameplay in general.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/a24ba0e2f40a9f9edd519300f0f96473efd410b1.png

Apprentice Arriving now uses a new Combat System that enables fluid combos and more thrilling battles due to a better AI, a better attacking system and an armor equipping system which can be smoothly handled. There are lots of changes and eventhough this is true we have only just started with the real game. Even Aclendi Woods is just a breeze of what's to come. So stay tuned!

Feel free to give us any feedback on our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/7jUgdkbWXb 
You are invited to see how Apprentice Arriving finally evolves and becoming the epic story we always wanted it to be!

Here are some comparisons with the previous version and the new one showing you how much the game has changed in terms of graphics and design.

We created a new model of Prince Landon with much higher graphics, more details, High Res textures, hair physics and dynamic motions. As you can see he is fearless, he is determined and ready for any challenge that lies upon him, no matter how hard it will be!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e2fa330e32f72f95ea618b74f0cd9d70da9c9ac1.png

Also we have polished the texture of the Balver monster because the old one didn't fit our art style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/36c4ab94e1c2fdf16f4208bd3f828b0204123191.png

The swamp area has been completely redone by replacing all assets such as trees, rocks and ground textures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/22a10c5e111484f1f4ccc05bf99e633fb83c7b65.png

The tree stump area needed an overhaul too as we realized the size didn't fit for what we had in mind. Also we wanted to make this part of the level more visually appealing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/e94aa0eb864605d432ba2f5746af65f06a022520.png

What secrets may the tree stump have for you? Well, you might find it out soon ... if you find a way to get to it …

Here are some additional comparisons of environments in Aclendi Woods which have been entirely changed. We wanted to have more variety so we also added a few forest clearings for more engaging battles and to make monster material farming a little easier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/715b7c27cb45c3305412055aea3d49bd1180fa14.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/9873280fe9a62b6db52b106d7d0ebf40b0b402ce.png

NEW MENU

A new menu is in the making. The menu will give you way more features than before such as Skilltrees, Potion Mixing, finally the long announced Destinyboard and much more. The menu is also fully optimized for gamepad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/7090583baafb873aef403cb73675e38a26f30299.gif

Check out this video which shows how the menu currently functions:

[previewyoutube=YrItGRwuNn0;full][/previewyoutube]


COMBAT SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT
We are working hard on the new Combat System to make it fluent, dynamic and epic.

What we can reveal so far:


 Each weapon type such as Short Sword, Longsword and Greatsword has it's own combo moveset
 We have added a feedback system that allows you to feel each hit even more
 You can move to all directions fluently to attack targets without having to lock on


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/dc5ef23df987ef89cff00678ad0d36207a5e9a07.png

Many areas are awaiting you! This picture shows the path to the new Tutorial Area where you will learn some basics. Important to say is that there are features that will be definitely altered as we progress with the development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/5a02b420dfebe0e3ebd13f8be2495711e828face.png

By completing quests you are not only rewarded with Items or Gold but some will even give you access to new areas of the map that are unreachable otherwise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/330cdbfee4275b7f780e9bda0e79ce70faf9debe.png

We are very happy about our Combo System as it allows us to design any combo we want. The combos are starting off rather simple but can become a little more complicated later on. Next to combos there will also be Weapon Stances where you can switch between Fast, Medium and Heavy Melee Stances. It will be possible to switch your stance during combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/55e4d28bf1318f6a09bedaf6d6b769cb4398d245.png

This update is part 1 of Aclendi Woods. Ultimately the level consists of 3 parts meaning that there will be 3 Major Updates to complete Aclendi Woods. With each big update we will unlock the next part of the level which will include new monsters, abilities, quests and many other exciting stuff!

This World Map shows you the areas you can explore for the moment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/de44f86a4a6674bc2f940f6d791f494cdd761ca8.png

Next Major Update will unlock this part of the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/66398ffb9ab045aec9a1323889336a9a0766b0be.png

Third Major Update will unlock the rest of the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/2e9184095afe3873e2d0a59f8c274a4233d6cb19.png

With the third update the map will be completed so that you can explore the entire map and this includes a boss fight. In our previous version you were fighting against a Balver EX monster however this was only a Miniboss. In Major Update 3 you will encounter the real boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/2f0a8793a181b1d9ac417d4d4daab8df317a0288.png

Another important aspect we want to reveal is that each Main Level has a Sub Level or a Secret Level. Those levels are usually hidden. Secret Levels can also be very difficult and not seldom you will need a specific item in order to enter them.

We are working on a roadmap for you which will explain what you can expect during the development of Aclendi Woods.

That being said we are already working on the next level. We don't want to spoiler much but one thing we can say is that the level has the name „The Path of Mt. Talarev“. We are very excited about it and we are sure you will like it as well!

So that's it for now. Everything starts here and we are already thrilled to present all the things we have planned so far!

Thank you very much for your support! See you in the next Major Update.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE COMING: 12/29/23!
notes.content:
We are proud to finally announce an update that was long in the making. This update completely transforms the game into a fantasy RPG with quests, new stunning environments, polished enemies and so much more! Many features have been added or changed. You can fight against some of our enemies and experience the new combat system which we are non-stop polishing.

This is a milestone. With each coming update, either smaller or larger we are coming closer to our vision for Apprentice Arriving and we are happy that you can now be a part of it.

We will also create a roadmap that is going to show you what you can expect within a time frame.
For now you will be able to complete some quests and get yourself familiar with the game. Some time later we will unlock the next large area with new polished monsters and exciting content!

Now we hope you will enjoy this re-creation of the game!


 - To Learn, To Experience, To Master

Apprentice Arriving

notes.title: DevLog #6 – 10/05/2023
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

Everything is being prepared and finalized for the update. After DevLog 5 we didn't have many new visuals and also don't want to spoiler too much here by showing everything in advance. That being said we are currently fully focussing on making some gameplay features functional. During the silence between DevLog 5 and this one a ton of programming has been successfully completed with very little bugs and we are excited about our new foundation of the game. We now have full control over designing and planning the game.

Smarter enemies and a great system overall
Thanks to our new enemy system enemies can be easily adjusted and expanded without any potential issues.

Our enemies are smarter and more dangerous: Some enemies will use nasty skills that can get you quite in trouble, some act in a different way if other enemy types are nearby and some will even support each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/356f0ab8c8243221da392eeb37f247809d7c2ac9.png

Armor sets can be equipped!
We finally made it! It was a lot of hard work and planning to create a system that allows you to equip and overlap armor parts but we have recently managed to do that. There might be some issues with specific armor parts still but in time we will get to that too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d379ee0aba56e49b0e3da80f565093ffbf8eb182.png

Checkpoint system completed
The dynamic checkpoint system is now done. Once you reach a Mana Circle checkpoint you can restore your Mana and your Health at the spot. Note that all killed enemies will respawn.

Sword scabbard system done
As we said before we had an idea to make sword scabbards work with each individual sword and we have done it. In order to make this stylish appearance work the requirement is that you wear an armor so that the belt is attached to the armor and scabbard. The system now works perfectly and we are happy to see it in our game.

Minimap design done
Yes our game needs a minimap we heard this many times before and you are all right with that. Fortunately we have figured out how to create that.
Another cool feature: The world map can even be opened while playing so that you can walk and see where you are going on the big map in real time.

Compass design done
In addition to the minimap you have a compass that gives you even better orientation. This will be every helpful especially if you are questing and need navigation to locate an area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/d55bbab67095c2fc7a9d1995cf4d498ed4291794.png

All combo sets for this version are completed
The combo sets for the weapon types such as: Short Sword, Longsword and Greatsword are polished and finished. Three more will come in time. We will add a page that you can open during gameplay which displays how to perform each combo.

Magic proctile casting almost done
Next to cool animations we have for casting spells and moving around we almost completed the projectile system for the character. It's a little different than before so you have to target an enemy with a crosshair to hit directly other than just lock on and shoot. We will see if this is ideal for the game but so far we do like it. Magic has no cooldown  with some exceptions for extremely powerful spells.

Interacting with NPCs
Our new quest system is very dynamic and therefore allows us to add quests to the game with ease. You can now talk to NPCs for accepting quests and for general conversations.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/143cf9a9ebffdaaadf418e2349746a13631fdc0c.png

Merchants and Monster Materials
You can also interact with merchants to buy goods with your gold. Gold is typically not dropped by enemies but can be found in treasure chests and be received as a reward when completing quests. We also have added monster materials. You need these materials for quests and later on you can modify your equipment with it.

Looting almost done
We are about to have a well working, dynamic looting system that is mainly based on your luck. However we are making sure that there are other good and easier ways to obtain rare monster materials than just by fighting monsters in the level.

Stamina for running and dodging + Destinyboard design
There is no stamina for physical attacks or casting spells but for running and dodging. Only with the Destinyboard you will be able to improve this. The Destinyboard will not come with the next update but rest assured that we are working hard to finally realize it. All the designs for the Destinyboard have been long completed which means we only have to integrate it into our new system.

Balancing of current enemies, weapons, exp, armors etc done
While numerous programming tasks have been sorted we also worked on balancing the combat and can say now that this is done too. There might be some minor tweaking here and there but the main design has been completed.

There are still other things we have worked on during that time however this could give you an idea on how far we really are. The update is coming this year and can be released pretty much anytime. As soon as we have it we can go from there and add more content easily. This means the game will be updated regularly and we can show you a roadmap to so you can see what you can expect within a time frame.

This DevLog might be the last one before the upcoming update. If everything goes well the real adventure is about to begin very soon.

notes.title: DevLog #5 – 07/28/2023
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

With big steps we are coming closer to the first small update where you can test out the new combat by fighting against 3 polished enemy types with 1 being new. The last couple of weeks we have also worked on completing the new Game Menu and a heavily improved Head Up Display design with awesome mechanics which we will show you in this DevLog.

Enemy combat refined and - Some enemies can Block
One of our main goals is to make the battles super epic. We want to make sure you are well equipped but so are your foes. There will be many crazy surprises you can be sure about that. Enemies will react to what you are doing and for instance can now block.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/df036f36427c3179bd05f1cf15400e0f04619203.png

Redesigned HUD (Head Up Display)
A fully redesigned HUD has been created. You will have better control over your skills with  gamepad and overall management with HP, MP, Potions will be much easier. You can now see directly how much HP and MP you have displayed as a number.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/0007e00249c7ed73d2e4b7c4ade041820c0742e8.png

Combo System finally about to be completed!
The last couple of weeks we have been working tirelessly on the combo system. It's very important to us that this works in the next update. You will be able to perform multiple combo sets. The attacks and animations are different for every weapon type such as Short Sword, Longsword, Greatsword etc but the buttons input stays the same to keep things more simple.

In-Game Menu almost completed
The Menu is a ton of work and it takes time especially with a small team. Here is a little sneak-peek of the Skills Page where you can quickly and easily switch out your skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/7090583baafb873aef403cb73675e38a26f30299.gif

Sword and Scabbard done Knights Armor comes next
We are happy that the knights outfit is about to be done. We are already working on nice sound effects like clattering chainmail noises and footstep sounds. Here we can show you how the sword and scabbard now looks. Some little refining need to be done on the texture. We are arleady excited to show you the end result.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/4ae41d6a0dceb9c840501d83a9510581d539a593.png

As we are coming to the end of this DevLog we are very happy to see that the progress is much better than we thought. Most of planning still happens in the background but the programming has now been accellerated. So far we can say the development progress is steadily ongoing and it should not take much more time until we have a playable version.

notes.title: DevLog #4 – 06/23/2023
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

Many tricky and complicated things are now completed and while we are working to make the version playable for you we have added some other stuff that weren't even planned for the update.

Buildings like residences, taverns, shops etc can be entered
Thanks to our 3D Artists and some nice assets from the Quixel Bridge Library we have many options to furnish the buildings. On the picture below you can see how Aldermans house now looks from the inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/654fd42b1ec263e6fefc5e4c5cb1ae6c702d084e.png

Aclendi Castle Guard Armor
Our modeller is almost done with the new armor that you can equip, including a new sword and a shield. The sword will not only increase your attack damage but also has other useful effects. Weapons now generally have positive and negative effects so you have to choose wisely which weapon to select for your playstyle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/b0d45b78be756482e80f942cd15e50f528c67a2a.png
It has been quite a tricky thing to design the sword scabbard while keeping an authentic design but as we said before - we love attention to detail! Sword scabbards are an underrated element in games as they are pretty difficult to attach to multiple armor sets but we arleady have an idea and are ready to take on that challenge! We can also say that many armors are fully planned and designed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38135849/650134b05f23c321f432b51e56b25ee6950ee6c2.png


New Game Menu
A new menu is in the making. The menu will give you way more features than before such as Skilltrees, potion mixing, finally the long announced Destinyboard and much more. The menu is also better optimized for gamepad than the previous one.

Check out this clip that shows how the menu currently functions with the mouse:

[previewyoutube=YrItGRwuNn0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Quest System Done
We are happy that we have a well working quest system. Right now the game designers are planning sidequests, secret or hidden quests - which are difficult quests that give you nice rewards.

New Boss
We don't want to spoiler much here but what we can reveal is there is indeed a new boss we are working on. For those of you who have played through the older game version, there was a Balver EX monster at the end but actually this is just a miniboss – not the real one.

As we all have to be very patient waiting to finally play the game, we know once it's here you will see that the game has completely changed in the way we wanted it to be when the project was first published on the Anime Messe Berlin in 2018!

We hope that with the next DevLog we can announce a playable version release date. With the resources we have we work all the time to make it happen.

notes.title: DevLog #3 – 05/30/2023
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

This time we were mainly focussing on the combos, animations and the movement in general. But there are also many other things we have finished.


Polished Attack Movement, Combat Voice and New Particle Effects!
We are working hard on polishing the combat system and making sure everything fits together. There hardly passes a day where the attacks are not tested over and over until we are finally satisfied and more importantly until it's cool and lots of fun!

Check out the videos below to see now a Longsword Spin Combo, the polished Short Sword Spin Combo and a new up knock strike! We have also added nice looking particle effects and powerful sounds for heavy attacks!

[previewyoutube=k1RNnAX96II;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[previewyoutube=iy4KQp5SeQE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[previewyoutube=siAHRhFQjkc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










New Enemy Type Model
In our previous DevLog we have announced a Knights Armor outfit but unfortunately it's not completely done yet as our main modeler is fighting with a cold. However we do have another model. Say "Hi" to the Canerus! A beautiful but wild wolf that will often attack you in packs who will try to surround you. We are currently working on animations and the AI behavior.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38135849/f13f4f1d338281070612cc226c47718bed9f4d88.gif

And NO, he is not Landons pet or campanion ... There has been a chatter about Landon getting a companion. But is there truth to it? Well, who knows ...


New Textures for Enemies and Additional Enemy Sounds
Over the last couple of days we have worked on new and better looking textures for some of the creatures. They will be even more fearsome and detailed. Now there are also sounds for the enemy variations that havn't been there before.

Equippable Armor Sets
We now have a system that allows you to equip single armor sets which will be: Helmet, Armor, Pants + Boots and Gloves.

Blocking with a Shield
Yes, we are working on shields as well so you can block incoming enemy attacks. Be careful though because some of the enemies can break through with ease. There is going to be a little shield symbol telling how long you can block, similar to a stamina bar.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38135849/998a7e0d4976ab9d5b2311bd3ebb33aa5ab18368.png


As we are getting closer to a playable version we are working on many features, models, SFX, VFX and so much more. That being said as soon as the enemies function as before – and better, we can release the next update so you can finally have a sneak peek of the new gameplay feeling and look.

And here we come to the end of this DevLog. The next log will be very exciting and close to the release so stay tuned guys, we almost made it!

notes.title: DevLog #2 - 05/17/2023
notes.content:
Hey gamers,

Since our last DevLog post we have worked really hard on the combat system and the animations.
New attacks Landon performs are going to be much quicker and more stylish.
Thankfully everything has accellerated and we are getting very close to the release of the long awaited update. Many things have happened after May 3th. Without getting into too much detail, here is some stuff we have recently finished:

Light Attacks and Heavy Attacks Combos
The last couple of weeks we have worked on the combos to make them fluent and very responsive 
on the keyboard as well as on gamepad. You will realize how smooth attacks now transition. 
Many combos for Short Sword, Longsword and Greatsword have recently been completed and polished.

Check out some movements:

[previewyoutube=XYKks22q5Xo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[previewyoutube=nafhATEwXc8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Combat SFX and Ambience
As mentioned before we are tweaking and improving pretty much everything. Last week we have finished really cool combat and ambience sounds.

NPC Alderman the Miller, Dialogues, Quests
NPCs, dialogues and some quests are done. They will be added to the game in short. Here is a clip showing Alderman the Miller. He will help Landon with his knowledge to find Dormum the home of the Wizards.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38135849/311635297d8fa9f6072c5fc56c68c1570aba7d68.gif

Voice Recordings – NPCs & Prince Landon
We like to give a big thanks to Asim Searah! At the Game Development World Championship 2021, 
Asim has live streamed the game and supported the project ever since. He is happy to voice act some characters in the game.

Our new voice actor Ryan Mayhan is already doing a fantastic job with Landon. A few dialogues
have been recorded and we are going over to the combat sounds which will be very exciting.

New Armor Set
We have almost completed modelling a new outfit for Landon which is a knights armor that belongs to the army of Aclendi. We are putting high attention to detail on this one and we are already excited to show it to you. Among many other things the armor will be included in DevLog 3# which will be posted earlier than DevLog #2 as the development is going super smoothly now.

Thats about this DevLog. Have a great day and see you in the next one!

notes.title: DevLog #1 - 05/03/2023
notes.content:
Hey gamers,

A lot of progress has been made since our showcase video where we presented you the brand new Aclendi Woods. Not only did we finally successfully switch from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5 and sorted all the lighting issues, bugs and other conflicts that come with it, we also created many cool assets!

Checkpoint System and Design
From now on you can save your progress at a checkpoint which is called – The Mana Circle.
As the name already suggests you cannot only save the game but fully restore your mana, health, neutralize status effects etc by stepping into the stone circle. This way you don't have to save every time you just want to restore your health. To save the game you can just rest on the Mana Stone next to it. Mana Circles are the only place where you can unlock skills and spend your level points.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38135849/6128ba8409c2831217639a033c3f436a89108597.png

Prince Landon New Character Model
Like we announced in our last post we created a completely new model of Landon with much better graphics, hair physics and dynamic motions! 
He is fearless, he is ready for any challenge that lies upon him.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38135849/2d305e53fc07ab302194d556b78bd4a44dcff225.gif

New Voice Actor for Prince Landon
People come and go and this is not any different in game development. After some misunderstandings occured the voice actor Chris Luhrs left our team. We wish him all the best! 
Our new voice actor is now Ryan Mayhan! Ryan fell in love with the project and his new role immediately. He will be the perfect candidate for our Prince.

NPCs and storytelling
Tirelessly we are working on new characters that are filling the world with life. 
In the next playable update you will be able to talk to them and dive into the story.

Combat System Improvement
We are working hard on the combat system to make it fluent, dynamic and most importantly, 
a lot of fun!

What we can reveal so far:

 Each weapon type such as Short Sword, Longsword and Greatsword has it's own combo moveset
 We have added a feedback system that allows you to feel each battle even more
 You can move to all directions fluently to attack targets without locking on


Thats about this DevLog. 
We'd love to see you in the next one! Until then have fun with whatever you do! :)

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
This update contains the following bug fixes and adjustments:

BUG FIXES

 fixed a Stone Head quest bug which was a gamebreaker
 player was not locked in dialogue 
 enabled Master Volume bar (Thanks to Asim Searah Twitch Streamer)
 inventory overlapped by messages


ADJUSTMENTS

 rebalanced frozen, burn, paralyze status effect probabilities
 removed all status effects from boss enemy
 improved visual frozen effect
 changed enemy behavior to be more reactive. Enemies don't ignore you
 anymore when you attack them. Enemies can hear and feel you but you can also sneak around them.
 Inventory can now be closed with ESC (Also thanks to Asim Searah)
 added a realistic fog

notes.title: Gamepad Support is finally here
notes.content:
We are very happy that the game finally supports gamepad controls as it was planned from the very beginning. In addition we have fixed a bug with the Steam Overlay breaking the players movement. You can see they key layout in the Main Menu.

We hope you like it! Feel free to send us any feedback. What do you like? What could be improved?
The team reads all comments.

How to activate gamepad controls:

Go to the Main Menu
Press on: Settings - Controls
Click on the checkbox next to "Enable Gamepad Controls"

This will activate controls suiting for gamepad.

We wish you a lot of fun!


Other things that this update includes...

BUG FIXES

 Enemies were sometimes unable to use stairs without getting stuck
 Menus overlapped if other UI's were already opened
 Fixed a bug that allowed the player to jump, attack, dodge etc when Inventory is open

ADJUSTMENTS

 The game is now paused as long as the Inventory is opened
 Removed Steam Overlay hint message from the Main Menu
 Changed order of using Skills for better PC controls

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
This update contains the following bug fixes and adjustments:

BUG FIXES

 Lightning Spell was sometimes in a loop when toggling from one enemy to another causing 
enemies to be permanently paralyzed 
 Lightning Spell had no cooldown and could be spammed
 Randomly some enemies didn't spawn properly (created well working enemy-spawners)
 Balver was floating towards player when Boxing Attack event was triggered

ADJUSTMENTS

 HUD and other UI elements will now disappears when any dialogues on the screen pop off and will reappear once the dialogue is done
 Balver Boxing Attack are now 6 hits instead of 1 and deals a lot of damage 
(We now highly recommend you dodge this deadly attack) !

notes.title: News from the Jewel Seeker Team
notes.content:
Our first environment and polishing update is out now. Graphics and lighting have been improved, a new area was added and we made several bug fixes. The team also worked on combat and AI enhancements that will ensure gameplay continues running smoothly. Because of the lockdown, the development was massively delayed, and we apologize for that. 
From now on regular updates will follow to give you a better immersion into the world of Maira.


 This update comes with a discount:
Get Apprentice Arriving now - Save 33%. Offer starts today 10 AM (PT) ends September 18th.

 Also a website will soon be launched where you can exchange ideas with like-minded people and give us feedback.


What else comes with this update...

 Several missing sounds have been added
 Enemies can now hear you but they are less insisting. (You can now sneak around enemies)
 The overall performance has been improved
 You can now attack in all directions making it easier to attack multiple enemies that surround you
 You can press attack while walking
 The level design has been adjusted and improved


Note that we are not a big studio with many employees, Publisher or investors.
We are dedicated professionals who are working to realize a game we dream of!
